# Existing Borrow plan
POLICY: Conservative, project controls redaction. No hosted services.
DECISION: reuse a maintained CSV implementation behind our export adapter.
PREFERENCE: ThinCSV, based on an older Node 18 evaluation. This provider may change on new evidence.
OPEN: exact current provider/version/runtime fit.
Revalidate actual runtime and current local capability before implementation.
files.PROJECT.md: Synthetic offline evidence. Current runtime is Node 22 on Linux ARM64. evidence/thincsv.md is a fixture release note supplied for this task. Existing local PlainCSV supports Node 22 ARM64, quotes commas/quotes/newlines, has internal license approval, maintenance this month, and approved security review for this fixture. It is in lib/plain-csv.js. Redaction remains our own business rule. These are fixture facts, not real external package claims.
files.evidence/thincsv.md: ThinCSV fixture release note: only Node 18 x64 is supported. Current intended Node 22 ARM64 is unsupported.
